dedupe_keys.name: aed設置公共施設一覧 evacuation shelters and public facilities

description: AED設置公共施設一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 甲賀市. 甲賀市内のAED（自動体外式除細動器）設置済公共施設. Coverage: 甲賀市. The portal files it under the publisher 甲賀市. Its tags are 位置情報. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-03-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
